subject: FND-1 (A7 terminal audit, MEDIUM): correction to the s_a4_hostile_critic_dossier A1 leak-window share
issued_by: A1/Lead (append-only addendum; the A4 dossier is evidence and is NOT rewritten)
correction: A4 claimed ~46% of half-month files carry a same-day intraday leak window at a 16-day guard. A7's independent recomputation shows the arithmetic: for 'a' files the bound is month/15 + 15d = month/30, which in a 31-day month is 1 day BEFORE end-of-month posting (leak) but exact in 30-day months; for 'b' files the bound M/30+15d = M+1/15, which meets or exceeds the promised ~15th-of-next-month posting in ALL month lengths (no leak). The leaky class is therefore 'a'-files-of-31-day-months only — approximately 29% of half-month files, not ~46%.
what_stands: The BINDING RULING is unchanged and remains exactly right: the minimum availability guard is >= 17 calendar days (FTD_CONSERVATIVE_AVAILABILITY@1 as amended in lane_verdicts.json). 17 days closes the real leak class ('a'-files of 31-day months) with one day of margin; the A4 dossier's own recommendation ('17-18d guard must be binding') anticipated this. No verdict, gate, or boundary changes.
lesson_recorded: an availability bound derived from cadence TEXT must be re-derived against the worst calendar month and each file class separately; the share of affected files was miscounted while the FIX was correct — always recompute the arithmetic, not just the conclusion (A7 FND-1)
